description: Expander for cruïnn, giving each of its six sawtooth waves its own output and its own phase modulation input; it goes immediately beside cruïnn, on either side of it

inputs.text: Displaces the phase of that variant: negative voltage moves the phase forward, positive voltage moves it back

outputs.text: The core sawtooth wave, unipolar positive
One of the five phase-displaced sawtooth variants, unipolar positive
One of the five phase-displaced sawtooth variants, unipolar positive, though the plugin names it Omega where the panel prints delta
One of the five phase-displaced sawtooth variants, unipolar positive, though the plugin names it Theta where the panel prints zeta

notes: It generates nothing of its own, and nothing reaches its outputs unless a cruïnn is standing against it
cruïnn can be on either side of it; with one on each side it follows the cruïnn on its left
